description: This file defines the CachedResult class within the ScssPhp\ScssPhp\Compiler namespace. It encapsulates the result of a SCSS compilation including the CompilationResult, parsed files, and import resolutions.

classes.name: CachedResult
classes.description: A class representing the cached compilation result, including methods to access the result, parsed files, and resolved imports.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CachedResult with the compilation result, parsed files, and resolved imports.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the CompilationResult object stored in the cache.

methods.name: getParsedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of parsed files with their parse counts.

methods.name: getResolvedImports
methods.description: Returns the list of resolved imports with their file paths.
